marks.title: Pulled gait
marks.text: She hangs from her pole tips, narrow, trailing a little behind them. The tips pull her along the wire; she makes no lift.

marks.title: She sees it
marks.text: A trolleybus on her pair of wires. No wind-up this time and no flare: one tip brake and one pull of her poles.

marks.title: Tips brake
marks.text: Her tips brake a little and her body swings forward under them. Through the bottom she pulls her poles in, and the swing speeds up as they shorten.
facts: 2.3 m, on their way to 1.0 m

marks.title: Release at 60°
marks.text: Both tips open. She has kept most of her speed, so the path is long and shallow.

marks.title: Up between the wires
marks.text: She rises through the wire plane just behind the trolleybus's collector shoes, narrow, touching neither wire.

marks.title: Apex, stretched
marks.text: No hoop. The backward turn the swing gave her is all she needs: 0.5 turn in the air, stretched out, brings her poles round from up and back to down and forward.

marks.title: The catch
marks.text: One tip per wire, landing already running at her speed. She has less speed than she started with, so there is nothing to shed and no circle.

marks.title: Swinging under
marks.text: She falls behind and under her tips. The tips cannot hold against the swing, so she kills it the gymnast's way: poles short near the top of each swing, long through the bottom, and the coils push only when the swing lets them.

marks.title: Pulled gait again
marks.text: Cruise speed, hanging a little behind her tips, the trolleybus behind her.
